name: Can accessibility modifications be completed in older Denver and Centennial homes?

mainEntity.name: Can accessibility modifications be completed in older Denver and Centennial homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, older homes across Denver and Centennial often feature narrower hallways, smaller bathroom footprints, and cast-iron plumbing that require careful structural and layout adjustments. Achieving accessible layouts in these homes frequently involves reframing non-load-bearing partition walls, modifying floor joists for walk-in showers, and updating old drywall. HH Remodeling inspects the underlying framing and subfloor conditions firsthand to design durable modifications that respect the home's original construction while modernizing its function.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, older homes in the Denver area can be modified by reframing tight doorways, updating subfloors for curbless entry, and reconfiguring compact existing bathroom layouts.
